description: Verify that the SD Reserved field (24 bits) of the notification is 0x000000
approach:
[Objective]
This case asserts a single SOME/IP-SD wire-format invariant: SD Reserved field (24 bits) must equal 0x000000. The harness drives DUT to emit a qualifying notification, captures it, and validates the field byte-precisely.

[Scenario — chronological]
1. Tester drives DUT to emit a notification (typically by completing OfferService prelude or sending a stimulus message).
2. Observation: captured notification's SD Reserved field (24 bits) == 0x000000   ← key check

[Pass condition]
SD Reserved field (24 bits) on the wire equals 0x000000.

[Fail condition]
• Fail_reserved_bits — SD reserved bits nonzero
• Fail_timeout — DUT did not emit a qualifying notification within the listen window

verdicts.Pass: DUT-emitted SD Reserved field (24 bits) == 0x000000 — normal
verdicts.Fail_timeout: No qualifying notification within listen window
